correctness.rationale: I rebuilt all filtration faces using oriented endpoint pairs, rather than the frozen numerical incidence labels, and computed signed boundary ranks exactly over Q: (11,37,30). The 163 augmented faces give reduced homology only in H2, dimension five. Orbit counting on invariant faces gave reduced Lefschetz traces (5,-1,-1,5,-1,-1) on rotations and 1 on every reflection; an invariant simplex with k vertex orbits contributes (-1)^(k-1), also valid for the augmented empty simplex. Both different reflection-chain counts sum to 1. The complex agrees with the pure one at this length (KOW Theorem 8.4). The central involution has trace equal to dimension, so is the identity; the quotient S3 character (5,-1,1) is exactly 1+2 Std, and the rotation image has order three. Replay the independent exact check with python3 -B /workspace/audit_math.py 4. Read the bundled verifier; did not run it.
